name: mail2telegram
description: Forward email to telegram with a Telegram Mini App inbox
author: TBXark

TELEGRAM_ID.description: Destination chat ids, comma separated. Get yours from [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot). Groups start with `-100`.

WEB_PASSWORD.description: Optional password for opening the Mini App in a plain browser outside Telegram. Leave empty to allow only the Telegram Mini App.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional [Resend](https://resend.com/docs/introduction) API key. Enables replying to and composing email from Telegram or the Mini App.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible API key used as the default summary backend. Can also be set later in the Mini App settings.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/build-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc && pnpm --filter @mail2telegram/web build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
